derelict_hull.name: Derelict Hull
derelict_hull.description: Dead trade-hull interior for a boarded "loot" derelict_ship (see game/screens/space_screen/derelicts.py's _build_loot_interior_config) - a dim, damaged metal deck with cold, unlit walls, no dock-lamp warmth. Paired with "space_backdrop": true so the wreck reads as breached to the void beyond its one lit room, not a healthy station.
